`artifacts` is a bundled Consuelo OS skill. Creates and revises durable outputs, validates rendered results, publishes stable artifact routes, and works with artifact history.

## When to use it

Invoke when the user asks to create, revise, publish, validate, inspect, search, or roll back a durable generated output through Consuelo Artifacts.

Typical requests include:

- “Create a durable launch plan and publish it.”
- “Revise this guide and keep the previous version available.”

## Enable it

```bash
consuelo add skill artifacts
```

Run `consuelo add skill` without a name to choose from the skills that are not currently selected. Remove it with:

```bash
consuelo remove skill artifacts
```

## What the agent loads

The installed metadata points to `skills/artifacts/SKILL.md` in the immutable OS runtime. The compact steering catalog advertises the active skill by name and description; the full `SKILL.md` body is loaded only when the workflow applies.

Metadata for this skill currently declares permission `draft` and `requiresApproval: no`. Those fields describe the skill contract; individual tools called by the skill still enforce their own authorization and safety rules.

## Boundary

Artifacts owns durable generated outputs. Sites is the delivery layer underneath it; do not create a second site-only artifact catalog.

## Verify

After enabling it, confirm `~/Consuelo/Skills/artifacts/SKILL.md` exists and that `artifacts` appears in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json`. A newly bootstrapped agent should then see `artifacts` in the Installed skills portion of steering.
